blocks.text: A patient who messages your clinic after hours usually wants to know when a doctor is available and how to reserve a slot. If the inquiry stays in Messenger while the front desk uses a notebook or spreadsheet, staff have to check several places to see what was promised. A digital booking system gives patients one place to request a visit and staff one schedule to maintain. Start with one appointment type Choose a service your team already books frequently, such as an initial dental consultation or a specialist follow-up.
